provenance.sourceText: [NL-R-003] For suppliers in the Netherlands, the legal entity identifier MUST be either a KVK or OIN number (schemeID 0106 or 0190)

countries.notes: LEGAL_ID is read as a KVK number. An OIN (0190) is a separate identifier this product does not collect.
